# Tim Gagnon Studio

> A comprehensive online art education platform offering painting lessons, courses, and creative tools for aspiring and experienced artists.

Tim Gagnon Studio provides structured painting instruction through acrylic and oil painting courses available in multiple formats (online, DVD, and in-person workshops), complemented by free creative tools and resources to support artist development. The platform emphasizes color theory, landscape painting, and practical art techniques through live workshops, recorded lessons, and interactive digital utilities.

## Key Topics

- Acrylic Painting
- Oil Painting
- Color Theory and Color Mixing
- Online Painting Lessons
- Landscape Painting
- Painting Tutorials
- Brush Sets
- Art Education
- Membership Program
- Proportion Grid Creator Tool
- Paint Mix Suggestion Generator
- Tonal Reference Photo Generator
- Photo to Line Drawing Tool
- Value Critique Tool

## Core Platform

- [Tim Gagnon Studio](https://timgagnon.com): Tim Gagnon Studio homepage: painting, drawing lessons and membership
- [Shop](https://timgagnon.com/shop): Main shop for painting lessons, courses, brush sets and membership

## Online Courses & Lessons

- [Acrylic Painting Lessons Online](https://www.timgagnon.com/product-category/online-lessons): Acrylic painting lessons, online courses and tutorials category
- [Oil Painting Lessons Online](https://www.timgagnon.com/product-category/oil-lessons-online): Oil painting lessons and online art courses category
- [4 Week Color Theory and Color Mixing Course](https://timgagnon.com/shop/online-lessons/4-week-color-theory-and-color-mixing-course-live-zoom-workshops): 4-week color theory and mixing course with live Zoom workshops
- [Lesson Sets](https://www.timgagnon.com/product-category/lesson-sets): Painting lesson sets combining acrylic and oil painting courses

## DVD Lessons & Workshops

- [Acrylic Painting Lessons On DVD](https://www.timgagnon.com/product-category/dvd-lessons): Acrylic painting DVD lessons and courses category
- [Oil Painting Lessons On DVD](https://www.timgagnon.com/product-category/oil-lessons-dvd): Oil painting DVD lessons and tutorials category
- [In-Person Workshops](https://timgagnon.com/product-category/in-person-workshops): In-person painting workshops in Orlando and Dallas locations

## Creative Tools

- [Proportion Grid Creator Tool](https://timgagnon.com/gridcreator): Proportion grid creator tool for drawing and painting aid
- [Paint Mix Suggestion Generator](https://timgagnon.com/paint-mix-suggestion-generator-beta-v-1-0): Paint mix suggestion generator tool for color mixing guidance
- [Tonal Reference Photo Generator](https://timgagnon.com/tonal-reference-photo-generator): Tonal reference photo generator tool for painting reference
- [Photo to Line Drawing Tool](https://timgagnon.com/photo-to-line-drawing-tool): Photo to line drawing conversion tool for artists
- [Value Critique Tool](https://timgagnon.com/value-critique-tool): Value critique tool for analyzing painting value and depth
